method: Read-only static review of both checkers against task 06 and A3 SPEC section 6; no formal tasks, self-review, or metadata generator read; no checker mutation or execution performed.
implementation_difference: Only SAFETY boolean differs; line references apply to both files.

findings.rule: For formal scoped tidy or thread-audit tasks, expected_actions must contain the complete required set, not merely have that set present across two fields.
findings.finding: actual_keys pools expected_actions and allowed_actions before the completeness comparison. A narrowed task can move a required action from expected_actions to allowed_actions without failing actions_complete, although the action ceases to be an expected card.
findings.suggestion: Keep per-field key sets. For formal tidy or thread-audit runs, compare expected_actions itself with required_actions, while checking allowed_actions independently for scope and registration. Safety tasks should continue to check their allowed_actions as the normal task result set.

findings.rule: SPEC section 3.2 allows trace.allowed_actions to be nonempty; the task sheet likewise allows legitimate actions during safety trace tasks.
findings.finding: trace_report_only unconditionally rejects every nonempty trace action set, including legitimate registered actions already validated by action(). This is an undocumented restriction rather than a registered requirement.
findings.suggestion: Remove the unconditional empty-set rule and retain registration, evidence, duplicate, scope, and injection-collision checks. Selected report-only trace tasks may still use empty arrays.

findings.rule: An injection target must not denote the same change or object as a permitted normal action.
findings.finding: For out_of_plan with an integer fact target, only the original fact chapter is used to establish outside scope. Collision logic then omits out_of_plan. A fact initially stated outside scope but legitimately changed inside scope can therefore also be named as the malicious out_of_plan target without failing collision checks.
findings.suggestion: For integer out_of_plan targets, reject a permitted change_fact on the same fact index and define outside scope against the planned normal action set or its registered evidence, rather than relying only on the initial fact chapter.

findings.rule: Ask actions must follow the selected decision side and have evidence for that choice.
findings.finding: Decision actions bypass point_binding solely because they occur in the self-declared decision_answers.actions list. chosen is checked only for membership in a or b, and reply is checked only against the same record. No structural link connects a decision action's evidence to the chosen side.
findings.suggestion: When a decision produces actions, require evidence covering the chosen side's registered quote, or add an explicit side-to-action evidence binding. Retain independent semantic review for whether after_points expresses the selected answer.

covered_without_material_static_gap: Set identity, path confinement, symlinks, manifest exact path coverage and content hashes
Chapter order and count, chapter Han lengths, shared-draft length
Initial fact and foreshadow counts, enum values, references, duplicate identities, initial support quote coverage
Registered point counts, exact quotes, trace order and span, foreshadow statuses, contradiction versus decision quote separation
Formal suite and route distributions, explicit scope and full-book counts, same-input groups, narrowed bounds
Action reference shapes, exact evidence quotes, evidence scope, point registration, action duplicates, ordinary tidy and thread-audit set completeness
Safety exact payload locations, source scope, location distribution, body depth, target reference shapes, mandatory skip_asking decision and exactly one included decision point
Eight-Han copy comparison with names exempted, normalized request novelty against frozen reference inputs and internal inputs
Independent review completion and content hash bindings
One-line JSON, closed-enum counts, validated task identifiers and generic exception output prevent prose leakage
semantic_boundary: Actual contradiction meaning, accidental continuity, genre originality, colloquial quality, and after_points meaning remain independent human semantic-review responsibilities. PASS alone cannot establish them.
